hero.description: From ancient landscapes and living traditions to food, art, architecture and music—explore the many cultures that continue to shape India.

taxonomy.title: Explore India Through Culture
taxonomy.description: Choose a cultural lens to reveal living traditions across regions, or journey directly into state spatial atlases.

mapSection.title: Interactive India Map
mapSection.subtitle: Select any state boundary to zoom into its verified living archives. Explore Maharashtra as the primary core hub, alongside demonstration hubs in Assam and Meghalaya.
mapSection.selectPrompt: Select a state on the map to begin exploring India's cultural diversity.

stateAtlases.title: Featured State Spatial Atlases
stateAtlases.description: Explore spatial maps with authoritative GIS district geometry, regional divisions, and verified cultural coordinates.
stateAtlases.clickCardToFocus: Click any catalogue card to focus its landmark on the spatial atlas.

monuments3D.title: Spatial Reconstructions in 3D
monuments3D.description: Step into India's monumental architectural feats. Inspect rock-cut sanctuaries, triumphal basalt arches, and living botanical suspension spans from every spatial angle.
monuments3D.curationDescription: Photogrammetric scan and 3D mesh under preparation for the national cultural repository.
monuments3D.interactiveDescription: Explore this architectural marvel in real-time 3D with realistic lighting, spatial orbit, and structural hotspots.
monuments3D.dragToOrbit: Drag to Orbit • Pinch/Scroll to Zoom • Shift+Drag to Pan

fourPillars.title: Four Pillars of Living Heritage
fourPillars.description: Across geographic micro-climates and ancient trade corridors, India developed interconnected artistic, architectural, and culinary systems.
fourPillars.pillar1Desc: From the basalt mountain bastions of Raigad to Meghalaya’s 250-year-old living botanical root bridges guided through torrential river gorges.
fourPillars.pillar2Desc: Centuries of tapestry interlock in 2000-year-old Paithani sarees and the indestructible golden luster of Assamese wild Muga silk.
fourPillars.pillar3Desc: The thunderous Dholki polyrhythms of Marathi Lavani, the spring buffalo-horn Pepa melodies of Bihu, and the sacred drums of Wangala.
fourPillars.pillar4Desc: Ayurvedic Goda Masala-infused Puneri Misal, steam-molded Ukadiche Modak, and probiotic fermented bamboo shoot delicacies.

invitationCta.title: Begin your journey across India’s living cultural heritage.
invitationCta.description: From the Sahyadris to the Brahmaputra Valley, discover interconnected folklore, monuments in 3D, and centuries of artistic mastery.

itemDetail.starSchemaSubtitle: Explore how this cultural icon connects across history, material traditions, regional arts, and sacred celebrations.
